GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiHyperlink class.

GetElement.description: Returns the hyperlink element using the position specified.

params.description: The position where the element which content we want to get must be located.
params.name: nPos

GetElementsCount.description: Returns a number of elements in the current hyperlink.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent element (a paragraph or an inline content control) that directly contains the current hyperlink.

returns.description: returns null if the hyperlink has no parent.

GetPosInParent.description: Returns the position (index) of the current hyperlink within its parent element.

returns.description: returns -1 if the hyperlink has no parent.

GetRange.description: Returns a Range object that represents the document part contained in the specified hyperlink.

params.description: Start position index in the current element.
params.name: Start

params.description: End position index in the current element.
params.name: End

GetScreenTipText.description: Returns the screen tip text of the hyperlink.

params.description: The text to display the hyperlink.
params.name: sDisplay

SetScreenTipText.description: Sets the screen tip text of the hyperlink.

params.description: The screen tip text of the hyperlink.
params.name: sScreenTipText

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiHyperlink object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles
